history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1818 in the North of Ireland and came to Chicago about 1867. He works as a coal heaver, and the household lives in the city's outer streets. The family's church is St. James's.
